 3 Kentucky Basketball Targets Announcing Decisions this Week
 Nick Roush @ RoushKSR 19h 3 Share Share 
 In one week, the Kentucky Wildcats will host the Manhattan Jaspers for the first game of the 2026-27 season. Before the action on the hardwood begins, some of the nation’s top prospects are ready to pull the trigger and announce their future college destinations.
 The Wildcats will be finalists in three separate decisions, beginning with Lewis Uvwo . The five-star prospect is the top-ranked center and No. 7 overall player in the 2027 recruiting class, according to the Rivals Industry Ranking. One of the nation’s top shot-blockers, Uvwo officially visited Kentucky in September when the football Cats hosted Alabama at Kroger Field. His announcement is expected to go live on Wednesday at approximately 3:30 PM EST. 
 In addition to Kentucky, Baylor, Providence, and Cal are Uvwo’s other three finalists. The Wildcats do not have momentum in the closing moments of this recruitment, but they are in a strong position with another talented center. Earlier this week, Joe Tipton submitted an RPM pick for the Cats to land 7-foot-5 center Cherif Millogo . 
 On Thursday, we’ll learn where Reese Alston will suit up to play college basketball. Another five-star talent, the son of Rafer “Skip to my Lou” Alston, is the third-ranked point guard and No. 9 overall player in his class. Kentucky, Louisville, LSU, Tennessee, and Wichita State will be the five finalists when he announces his decision on Thursday at 4:00 PM EST. 
 The commitment carousel continues to spin on Friday, when DeMarcus Henry decides. The No. 3 overall player and top-ranked wing in the 2027 class is down to Kentucky, Arkansas, Louisville, and North Carolina. Mark Pope made a trip to Arizona on Tuesday to make one final push for the talented prospect, but the Tar Heels are gaining momentum ahead of Henry’s announcement.
